degree_identification_note: The p1_exp_basis plateau rule (residual within 3x of the Lmax=14 floor) selects L*=9 here, but the residual curve does NOT collapse at L*=9: it decays smoothly from L=2 (9.6e-01) through L=4 (2.6e-02) to L=14 (7.8e-06). The experiment panels tested in p1_exp_basis show a true collapse by a factor of ~1e4 at an exact degree; this theory-like panel does not, so it has no exact finite angular degree.
failures: No (m_ini, m_final, mu, gauge, basis) selection of the theory/DMEs block reproduces the theory dense panel: best relative residual after a single complex scale is 0.5313 (energy index 0), and 0 of 144 candidates fall below the 2% reproduction threshold.
The theory-like dense panel is not an exactly finite-degree Legendre polynomial: the residual only reaches the double-precision round-off level (3.968e-06) near L=90, not at L=4.

The theory/DMEs T_kin axis is not the photon-energy axis: T_kin spans 0.338..1.217 a.u. (9.18..33.11 eV) while the panel photon energies span 23.249..41.839 eV, so the two blocks were matched by ascending index, not by an explicit shared energy coordinate.
